hero.lead: I designed and ran two open source data platforms in production: 4.5M+ products, from ingestion to infrastructure. Then I plugged an AI agent into them.
about.title.html: I build the data chain end to end.
about.p1: I am a Data Engineer. Ingestion, modeling, deployment, reporting: I own the whole chain, and I measure it.
about.p2: As E-halal's volunteer Chief Engineer (Oct. 2025 – June 2026), I designed Halal Open Food Facts and Halal Open Beauty Facts: architecture, import of 4.5M+ products, self-hosted infrastructure. I then integrated Halal Assistant, an AI agent that queries the database in plain language.
about.p3: I am a first-year Master's student in Data Modeling at Université de Lille, after a Master's in Applied Statistics and Business Intelligence and a Bachelor's in Actuarial Science at ISTA, University of Burundi.

ha.lead: An AI agent built into Halal Open Food Facts and Halal Open Beauty Facts. It queries the product database through RAG and answers in plain language, with a nuanced status and a link to the source record.
ha.chat.label: Animated demo of a conversation with Halal Assistant
ha.chat.warn: ⚠ AI assistant, it can make mistakes. Check the product label.
ha.chat.q: I want halal milk, what do you suggest?
ha.chat.intro: I found 5 products for “halal milk”. Product names don't always make it clear that it is milk, so check the record before buying.
ha.chat.r1.html: Goldium crémeux: compatible based on the listed ingredients, but the halal label was declared by contributors and is not verified.
ha.chat.r2.html: Maître Fromager: compatible, halal label declared by contributors, not verified.
ha.chat.r3.html: Code 6111259092525: ambiguous. An ingredient of uncertain origin or conflicting labels.
ha.chat.caption: Reconstruction of a real exchange on halalopenfoodfacts.org, translated from French (question rephrased, answer shortened).
ha.arch.label: Halal Assistant architecture diagram
ha.arch.caption: Simplified architecture: answers are grounded in the records retrieved from the database.
ha.does.title: What the agent does
ha.does.2: Assesses halal compliance from the ingredients.
ha.does.3: Helps users choose halal products that fit their request.
ha.guard.title: Safeguards
ha.guard.1: Permanent warning: the AI can be wrong, check the label.
ha.guard.2: Nuanced status: compatible, ambiguous, label verified or only declared.
ha.guard.3: Every product cited links to its source record.

p1.title: Halal Open Food Facts & Beauty Facts platforms
p1.desc: Two open source data platforms, from ingestion to infrastructure. 4.5M+ products, 12,000 visitors a month.
p1.d1: Streamed import of the Open Food Facts and Open Beauty Facts CSV dumps into PostgreSQL, then hourly delta sync (Celery Beat).
p1.d2: Sync time cut from 9 h to 55 min (−90%); 25,000 Celery tasks processed per day.
p1.d3: Secured infrastructure on an OVHcloud VPS (HTTPS, backups, restricted access): 99.5% availability, median API response < 300 ms.
p1.d4: Open source contribution process (CI, documentation, governance): 350 registered contributors, 40 pull requests merged.
p2.title: NYC Yellow Taxi Big Data pipeline
p2.desc: 40 million rides processed with PySpark, 6 times faster than with pandas.
p2.d1: PySpark pipeline on Parquet data: 40 million rides, processing time divided by 6 compared with pandas.
p2.d2: Four machine learning models compared; best model R² = 0.87.
p2.d3: Interactive Streamlit dashboard to report the indicators.
p3.title: Insurance claims prediction
p3.desc: Modular ML pipeline: 5 models compared, best AUC = 0.81.
p3.d1: Hyperparameter search (RandomizedSearchCV), 5-fold cross-validation, configurable dataset mapping.
p3.d2: Model serialisation with Joblib, ready for production.
p4.desc: Query your documents in plain language, with verifiable sources.
p4.d1: Multi-format extraction (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, HTML…) and page-level chunking.
p4.d2: Hybrid word/character TF-IDF search; citations built from metadata, never from generated text.
p4.d3: Runs locally without an API key; optional LLM through an OpenAI-compatible API.
p5.desc: University management platform for ISTA, University of Burundi.
p5.d1: Flask/PostgreSQL application: students, faculty, courses, library and internal messaging.
p6.desc: Classified ads marketplace for North Africa.
p6.d1: Geographic search, guided listing creation, buyer/seller messaging, automatic moderation and back-office.
p7.title: ISOKO IRAMA / SESA study
p7.desc: Statistical analysis of 489 respondents for an EU-funded project.
p7.d1: Methodological split between organisations and individuals, and field data collection via KoboCollect.
p8.desc: Personal finance tracker in BIF/EUR, in a single HTML page.
p8.d1: Data synchronised through the GitHub Gist API.

x2.title: Assistant consultant, project monitoring and evaluation
x2.b1: Collected and analysed field data with KoboToolbox: 1,200 households surveyed, 45 indicators tracked, 6 quarterly reports.
x2.b2: Automated data cleaning and consolidation: report preparation cut from 3 days to 4 hours.
x3.title: Intern, Data Science applied to insurance
x3.b1: Prototyped AI in life insurance pricing: 50,000 contracts, gradient boosting, prediction error 12% lower than the baseline model.
x3.b2: Presented the results to technical management: recommendations adopted for the pilot phase.
